_comment: alert fingerprint -> Grafana panels to attach as visual evidence in the
Only VERIFIED entries belong here. A wrong panel id renders a real-looking
picture of the wrong graph, which is worse than no evidence. Discover and
confirm ids against thanos-grafana.ops.veritone.com before adding one:
Lookup key: the alert's own alertname first, then the case-library
fingerprint. Keys are matched the way the alert reads in Slack, so a
compound key ('KubePodsNotReady / KubePodCrashLooping') also matches each
half on its own. {env} in a variable value is replaced with the alert's
See config/panel_map.example.json for both accepted entry shapes.
STILL UNMAPPED (deliberately): Kube*, NSQ/backlog, PandoLogic and Runscope
alert types. thanos-grafana carries many near-identical per-cluster copies
of those dashboards and picking the right one is a judgment call for whoever
knows which cluster each alert refers to - not something to guess.

Engine failure rate above 15%._verified: 2026-08-24 — dashboard 'aiWARE Engine task failure rate 2'; its $env variable takes exactly the aiw-xxx keys this repo uses, so {env} substitution lands on the right cluster.
